description: Offline normalized facility evidence from a verified immutable Pennsylvania childcare acquisition; no requests, entity matching or national publication.
redirect_policy: No network requests or redirects; all inputs must already be retained within datahub.
retry: No automatic retries. Verification or quality failures preserve acquired source inputs for inspection and local reprocessing without downloading again.
checkpoint: Read and independently replay the immutable acquired manifest. Publish normalized, quarantine and summary artifacts under a new UUID; manifest last.
idempotency: Never overwrite acquired data or existing normalized releases. Exact source manifest hash and transformation version identify the derivation; explicit reprocessing may create another immutable release.
cancellation: Cooperative checks and event-loop yields during replay, normalization and precommit persistence. Clean only owned incomplete output; preserve uncertain postcommit publication for inspection.
retention_profile: Internal immutable derived facility records, source-linked quarantine references and conservation evidence; original acquisition remains separate and unchanged.
